sloka: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल गुणैरतुलविक्रम ।पृथिवीं नार्हसे हन्तुं वशे हि तव वर्तते ।। ७.८३.१५ ॥
transliteration: sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla guṇairatulavikrama ।pṛthivīṁ nārhase hantuṁ vaśe hi tava vartate ।। 7.83.15 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, O one of unequalled valor by your virtues, you ought not to destroy the earth, for it is indeed under your control.
